title: sida cordata
intro: Sida cordata, commonly known as the water chestnut or water spinach, is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae) native to tropical Asia. It is widely cultivated and used as a vegetable in many parts of the world. The health benefits of Sida cordata include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Sida cordata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
